cues.speaker: AUTHOR
cues.text: Our first story stops on the night of victory. The quarrel over the duel comes from an account Thiébault said he heard from Lannes's aide; the Guard cavalry sequence follows Rapp's later memoir within a narrow scope. We reconstructed the conversations and the lives of unnamed soldiers. Please remember that these memoirs are not recordings of that day. Beside tonight's cheering, we have left a place for those who did not return.
